木: Wood — the phase of growth and outward expansion; in a chart it reads as initiative and development.
火: Fire — the phase of peak expression; in a chart it reads as expression, visibility and warmth.
土: Earth — the phase of stability and seasonal transition; in a chart it reads as grounding and mediation.
金: Metal — the phase of contraction and structure; in a chart it reads as order, precision and resolve.
水: Water — the phase of stillness and storage; in a chart it reads as thought, adaptability and resource.
